title: Joseph Shine v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Joseph Shine v. Union of India, (2019) 3 SCC 39
content.holding: Adultery (IPC 497) struck down. BNS does not revive it. Marital infidelity is not, by itself, a crime.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 194 of 2017; 2018 INSC 898; (2019) 3 SCC 39.
